title: Touring with a big band in 1942
summary: After the Famous Door he toured with a big band, reaching California late in 1942.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: The -- you left there I think in about the beginning of February or early in the winter, of 1942 -- you closed at the Famous Door, and you were to have -- I think there was some plan, didn't you have a plan, to take a big band on tour, because you did go on tour with a big band, for a short period, at least, in 1942?
Was that, again, a recreation of the group more or less, or at least some members of the group that you had had in '39 and '40?

There were certainly some members -- I can't remember the personnel now, but that's ... let's see now, we did that tour now and came back to New York and then did another tour that took us on to California. We wound up in California, I think, in November or December of '42.
